title: Prove the coupled coarse-grid dirty-reader minimax (no new κ)
body:
For A=[[1,2],[-2,1]], M=2^b, integer |x_j|<=B and arbitrary dirty helpers, prove the global optimum over every integer lift L of worst squared Euclidean coarse-output error:
min(ceil(3B/M)^2, 2 ceil(B/M)^2).
Both branches have explicit attaining lifts in the inherited four-block architecture. A one-cell budget is possible exactly when M>=3B; a sqrt(2)-cell budget exactly when M>=B.

New relative to #6685's scalar law and #6666's approximate capacity: coupled congruences create a choice between concentrating and balancing error. Complex-linear lifts cannot use the concentrated improvement. Equal Smith factors do not determine fixed-chart error; an even-determinant control exposes falsely independent helper phases.

Base: 7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a.
#6666: 042b4ee85f64f4b3279426e2ed10191296448e6c.
#6685: 9e6c76ebf56fcd968c1383f00688152114f9dc79.
All source pins and the retained census cut are in the package.

Reproduce (CPython 3.12, stdlib):
```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/coupled-coarse-grid-reader
```
Expected: PASS_COUPLED_COARSE_GRID_READER and PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE.

Executed: 17,050 forward/inverse fixtures, 250 joint histograms, 93 finite optimization cases covering 14,091 residuals, 640 headroom corners and 16 rejection controls. Normal/-O receipts agree. Separate proof/direct-floor review, committed bytes/modes, export integrity and Git-free replays pass; the remote tree matches. Finite optimization covers b=0..4, B=1..3*2^b using a proved cutoff; the universal theorem is the written proof.

The six-word reversible lowering needs no clean scratch, 2P(L)+12 signed ADDs and eight constant translations for b>=1, with explicit headroom. Shifted word views are an explicit logical capability needing a physical implementation.

No new κ. This is an algebraic census cut, without a literal P104 caller or productive target-credit proof. Other grids/encodings and unrestricted circuits remain open; all five selected assumptions remain. No hosted CI, native build, selected cold replay or human/formal acceptance. Full-history preflight refused the shallow checkout.

By @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and separate review. Credit Ali Romman (#1135/#5615), Nick Petalas (#6666), ToikY (#6685) and retained lineage. Apache-2.0.
